recipe.visualDefinition: A full-length outdoor portrait of a male and female duo sitting back-to-back on a large rock against a soft blue water background, featuring high-contrast 1960s mod fashion and bold script typography at the top.
coreVisualRelationships: Back-to-back seating creates a central vertical axis
Vibrant red and blue stripes contrast with silver metallic textures
Warm skin tones and rock textures pop against the cool blue water

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subjects are centered horizontally, occupying the lower two-thirds of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large grey rock serves as the physical and visual base for the composition.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the bold black text at the top, move down the subjects' leaning heads, and follow the lines of their legs toward the bottom corners.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample negative space in the upper third, filled by the soft blue water and sky.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep red and royal blue (striped suit)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the clothing against a desaturated, high-value background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Round, high-contrast script with decorative swashes
letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing with overlapping swashes
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital letters feature exaggerated circular flourishes
Lowercase letters are compact with high x-height
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Color-coded hierarchy using two different shades of the same script style.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the thick-to-thin contrast and loops

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a photograph of a man in a red and blue vertical striped mod suit and a woman in a silver sequined jumpsuit sitting back-to-back on a rock by a calm blue lake. Soft 1960s film grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add two lines of centered script text in the upper third. The first line should be bold black, the second line should be a slightly smaller burnt orange script.

verificationChecks: Is the text centered in the upper negative space?
Does the clothing reflect 1960s mod fashion?
Is the background a soft, desaturated blue?

postGenerationChecks: Verify the back-to-back pose is maintained.
Ensure the script font has visible swashes.
Check that the red/blue stripes are distinct.
Confirm the silver jumpsuit has a metallic sheen.
recipe.reuseFormula: 1960s Mod Duo + Back-to-Back Pose + Coastal Rock + Soft Blue Water + Stacked Script Typography
